Custom Plugin Node is planned and not yet available in the runtime.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Plugins](../categories/plugins.md) |
| Status | Can't run yet |
| Search words | plugin, custom, extension |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

The pins and settings of an extension node come from the plugin or Python node that provides it; the extension's own page lists them.

## Settings

The node has no settings.

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
